name: Peer-to-peer rental index: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 (per-GPU-hour, verified hosts)
region: global (NL, TH, SI, CZ, FR, CA, US hosts observed)
price_basis: USD per GPU-HOUR for the GPU component, verified peer-to-peer hosts, 1-GPU bundles, observed 2026-10-03. Asking rate, NOT a realised rental. Excludes the host's disk/storage charge and any broker SLA premium.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-vast-rental-api. BAND: n=14 verified 1-GPU H100 SXM hosts, range $1.6863-$3.5004/GPU-hr, median $2.4704. PER-GPU-HOUR, DERIVED: the API returns dph_total (USD/hr for the whole bundle) for multi-GPU nodes; dividing by num_gpus is my derivation, not a VAST-published per-card rate. CONFIGURATION EFFECT, measured not assumed: 8-GPU bundles are CHEAPER per card on the same platform (n=7, range $1.6808-$5.4736, median $2.3335 vs $2.4704 for 1-GPU), so any per-card figure must state the bundle size it came from. CROSS-CHECK against managed list pricing: RunPod lists H100 SXM 80GB at $3.49/hr for a managed instance with CPU/RAM attached (sup-price-runpod-on-demand). RunPod sits ABOVE this entire peer-to-peer band, which is the managed-vs-marketplace premium made visible. Both are kept, neither is averaged.
